seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [reflection,wall] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Mechanics: 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (axis ring 10, pieces ring 5, targets solid 11, reflections 4); A1/A2 move selected axis/piece one row, A3/A4 move a piece one column (blocked by edge/other pieces; axis A3/A4 = no-op).
Reflection of each off-axis piece block at row 2A-r, skipped off-board or on piece blocks; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Render per block: ring = top of piece>reflection>target>wall>bg 9; centre = first solid (target 11, selected-axis dot 0) else first fill (selected piece 0, reflection 4) else 9.
HUD column 63: one 11->12 per effective (state-changing) action. Passes stateless too; hidden memo only keeps piece identity for touching pieces.
Hint (target A1 touching [reflection,wall] h,pixels vs no_change) = target re-extraction as the moving axis/reflections occlude it, not a target mechanic; axis blocking by piece rows is unobserved here and not implemented.
